_comment: Shared cluster reference data, read by every skill's scripts/build_job.py via --species.
Not pipeline-version pinned, so it lives once at the repo root instead of being duplicated
per skill (DESIGN.md 2). To add a species or bump an Ensembl release, edit this file only —
no Python change is needed anywhere.
genomes.<species> keys are referenced by each skill's CONFIG['species_map'] values:
species                -> the literal species name (scdownstream's 'species' param)
fasta, gtf             -> genome FASTA / gene annotation (rnaseq, scrnaseq, differentialabundance)
gene_sets_ensg         -> gProfiler GMT keyed on Ensembl gene IDs (differentialabundance, RNA-seq)
gene_sets_name         -> gProfiler GMT keyed on gene symbols (differentialabundance, mass_spec)
background_gene_names  -> protein-coding gene-symbol list, gprofiler2 background (mass_spec)
protein_fasta          -> UniProt protein sequence FASTA for DIA search (quantmsdiann)
A species missing a key that a run needs is a hard error naming the key, never a silent
fallback — so a partial entry cannot send an analysis at the wrong reference.
